name: singlet_genetics_clonal_substructure_inference
title: Clonal and subclonal grouping of tumour cells
description: Assigns tumour cells to clones, and to a clone tree where the method gives one, from copy-number states inferred from expression (scevan, the default), from phased allele counts (numbat), or from heteroplasmic mtDNA variants (mquad). Writes obs/clone_label and, where the method provides them, obsm/clone_posterior and uns/clone_tree. Use scevan for expression-only data and numbat only when a phased allele table is set. Do not use it to call the variants it groups, to score agreement with DNA clones, or to infer copy-neutral events from expression alone.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI, or a workspace handle, holding counts or mtDNA layers.

method.description: scevan for expression-only data; numbat with an allele table; mquad for mtDNA layers.

reference_obs_key.description: obs column marking normal reference cells; required for numbat, null lets scevan classify normal cells.

device.description: Execution device; cuda applies only to the planned HMM and mixture kernels.

seed.description: Seed for mixture initialisation; identical inputs and seed reproduce the labels.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without computing clones.

overwrite.description: Replace existing clone members instead of failing.

allele_table.description: Dataset table with phased alt and ref allele counts; required for numbat.

min_llr.description: Minimum log-likelihood ratio for calling a copy-number segment.

beta_vega.description: Segmentation beta; higher values give coarser segments.

min_dp.description: Minimum depth for a cell-variant to enter variant selection.

min_ad.description: Minimum alternate reads for a cell-variant to count as alternate.

min_cells.description: Minimum cells carrying the minor component for a variant to be kept.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: finished inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: executing as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obs/clone_label. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: For completed runs: method, n_clones, n_cells, unassigned_fraction, clone_sizes, tree_method (where a tree is built), n_informative_variants (mquad). Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
